# Worked answers

One design, one question per file, produced by the binary in this tree. They
are here so an agent can see the shape of an answer before asking for one, and
so a change to that shape shows up as a diff rather than as a surprise.

**Generated — do not edit.** `make examples` rewrites them; `cargo test --test examples` regenerates and compares, so a change that was not meant
fails rather than lands. The design is `design.sv` in this directory, exported
with the `rtl-designdb` the submodule pins.
